page.overview:
What is Mount Potalaka?

Mount Potalaka sits where the sky and sea seem to merge, and its wreathed with holy light. The mountain is made up of five different-coloured stones - red, yellow, green, deep purple, and blue.

On the peak of the mountain is a garden containing rare flowers, divine herbs, precious trees, golden lotuses, and Guanyin's sacred bamboo grove. There was also a paved hall where her disciples worshipped.
